title: Comparative computational and experimental analyses of some natural small molecules to restore transcriptional activation function of p53 in cancer cells harbouring wild type and p53(Ser46) mutant.
authors: Shefrin, Seyad; Sari, Anissa Nofita; Kumar, Vipul; Zhang, Huayue; Meidinna, Hazna Noor; Kaul, Sunil C; Wadhwa, Renu; Sundar, Durai
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子模拟和实验研究天然小分子恢复p53(Ser46)突变体与p62的蛋白-DNA转录激活互作，虽涉及TF-DNA相关转录调控，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非直接DNA结合，方法可迁移至TF-DNA建模。
abstract: Genetic mutations in p53 are frequently associated with many types of cancers that affect its stability and activity through multiple ways. The Ser46 residue present in the transactivation domain2 (TAD2) domain of p53 undergoes phosphorylation that blocks its degradation by MDM2 and leads to cell cycle arrest/apoptosis/necrosis upon intrinsic or extrinsic stresses. On the other hand, unphosphorylated p53 mutants escape cell arrest or death triggered by these molecular signaling axes and lead to carcinogenesis. Phosphorylation of Ser in the TAD2 domain of p53 mediates its interactions with transcription factor p62, yielding transcriptional activation of downstream pro-apoptotic genes. The p53 phosphorylation causes string-like elongated conformation that increases its binding affinity with the PH domain of p62. On the other hand, lack of phosphorylation causes helix-like motifs and low binding affinity to p62. We undertook molecular simulation analyses to investigate the potential of some natural small molecules (Withanone (Wi-N) & Withaferin-A (Wi-A) from Ashwagandha; Cucurbitacin-B (Cuc-B) from bitter Cucumber; and Caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE) and Artepillin C (ARC) from honeybee propolis) to interact with p62-binding region of p53 and restore its wild-type activity. We found that Wi-N, Wi-A, and Cuc-B have the potential to restore p53-p62 interaction for phosphorylation-deficient p53 mutants. Wi-N, in particular, caused a reversal of the alpha-helical structure into an elongated string-like conformation similar to the wild-type p53. These data suggested the use of these natural compounds for the treatment of p53(Ser46) mutant harbouring cancers. We also compared the efficiency of Wi-N, Wi-A, Cuc-B, CAPE, and ARC to abrogate Mortalin-p53 binding resulting in nuclear translocation and reactivation of p53 function and provide experimental evidence to the computational analysis. Taken together, the use of these small molecules for reactivation of p53 in cancer cells is suggested.
abstract_zh: p53的基因突变常与多种癌症相关，这些突变通过多种途径影响其稳定性与活性。p53反式激活结构域2（TAD2）中的Ser46残基发生磷酸化，可阻断其被MDM2降解，并在内源性或外源性应激下导致细胞周期阻滞/凋亡/坏死。另一方面，未磷酸化的p53突变体可逃逸这些分子信号轴触发的细胞周期阻滞或死亡，进而导致癌变。p53 TAD2结构域中Ser的磷酸化介导其与转录因子p62的相互作用，从而激活下游促凋亡基因的转录。p53磷酸化导致其呈绳状延伸构象，增强其与p62 PH结构域的结合亲和力；而缺乏磷酸化则形成螺旋状基序，与p62结合亲和力较低。我们进行了分子模拟分析，以探究一些天然小分子（来自南非醉茄的醉茄素A（Wi-N）和醉茄内酯A（Wi-A）；来自苦瓜的葫芦素B（Cuc-B）；以及来自蜂胶的咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）和阿替匹林C（ARC））与p53的p62结合区域相互作用并恢复其野生型活性的潜力。我们发现Wi-N、Wi-A和Cuc-B具有恢复磷酸化缺陷型p53突变体p53-p62相互作用的潜力。特别是Wi-N，能将α-螺旋结构逆转为类似于野生型p53的绳状延伸构象。这些数据表明，这些天然化合物可用于治疗携带p53(Ser46)突变的癌症。我们还比较了Wi-N、Wi-A、Cuc-B、CAPE和ARC在消除Mortalin-p53结合、促进p53核转位及再激活p53功能方面的效率，并为计算分析提供了实验证据。综上所述，建议使用这些小分子在癌细胞中再激活p53功能。
